status_note: one seed of the E007 harness: evidence only when run at the pinned scale from the frozen commit and judged by aggregate.py under criteria.toml; the exit status and the coverage and falsifiers lists below are the harness's own reading of the same rules

procedure.transport: the real PodWire request frame codec (encode_request, decode_request, MAX_BODY_BYTES enforced) in process; no network

model_pins.base_checkpoint: none: seeded random weights, no checkpoint

selection.corpus: synthetic token sequences from a seeded generator
selection.rule: deterministic generator, sequence i derived from seed and index i, in index order

unsupported.network_transport: frames cross the real PodWire request frame codec in process; no socket, no iroh and no second host is involved (E008)
unsupported.restore_path: no KV is restored on a Pod, and the downstream cache has no persistence (no snapshot, tier write or restore): the restore path of the invalidation coverage matrix does not apply

measurement_notes.wire_kv_page_bytes: bytes of any admitted payload that does not decode as an allowlisted schema, or that matches the digest of a KV page held by either pod or carries a window of one; legitimate traffic only: the activation control and every adversarial probe are excluded; every payload is scanned as sent (each chunk) and every valid frame as reassembled, because a page can straddle two chunks
measurement_notes.bitwise_mismatch_count: logits of every prompt row and decode step, and the K and V bytes of every layer on each pod, of the whole stack on one pod against (a) the two stages in process through the boundary cast and (b) the two stages with every frame crossing the wire; plus the continuation from a downstream cache hit against the recomputation
measurement_notes.typed_rejection: an adversarial attempt must end in a Rejection (or ChainFault) of the variant a hand-written table pins; any other outcome is attempts_without_typed_rejection or verdict_mismatches
measurement_notes.frame_rate: a completed frame holds one of the principal's 64 table slots until its signed deadline plus the skew bound; the cases sign deadlines 100 ms ahead and send a frame every 25 ms, so at most 45 slots are in use
